# P1 Canonical Alignment — §1 Return of Zero

**Wave:** T10 / #11.  
**Movements:** 13–18.  
**Canonical routing authority:** `working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/P1-48-MOVEMENT-CANONICAL-PROPAGATION.md`.

This supplement is authored; generated room projections remain generated.

## Section burden after T09

§1 owns the **first advent of zero**. [A10](../arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) is the governing Argument: zero becomes an operative mathematical sign through historical/formal development. The section then opens the Two-Ones problem of [A11](../arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and the trust/account pressure of [A15](../arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md)/[A23](../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) without stealing the terminal office of [A36](../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md).

The lock is exact: **[A10](../arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) mathematical sign first; [A36](../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) the same exact sign later becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be mathematical sign.** Zero is therefore not retained as an ordinary Concept node; its history belongs in Episteme, its formal operations in Matheme, and its argument offices in [A10](../arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md)/[A36](../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md).

## Release

§1 hands §2 not a mystical zero detached from arithmetic, but a disciplined sign whose widening role now forces the problem of One/All and the two conjugate logics of differentiation and gathering.
